audit.whatIsWrong: diff reads HARD while diffRating is 4/10, tone is the green favoured colour and report[14] says 'Favoured matchup'. The page renders two opposite verdicts.
audit.why: 50.37% win rate and an early-dominant, late-losing shape: this is a favoured lane that expires, not a hard one.
audit.corrected: diff FAV; diffRating 4/10 and carryRating 9.5/10 unchanged.

audit.whatIsWrong: Chart on disk reads Swain/Skill/Kayle/Kayle/Swain/Kayle/Kayle, which disagrees with the packet and with the mirror (which aligned the chart to the packet in both layers). It also puts Level 6 to Swain even though its own why says Divine Judgment absorbs the drain.
audit.why: Kayle is melee and dashless at 2, so Level 2 is Swain's; Level 3 is the last even stage before her spikes; Level 6 belongs to Kayle because Divine Judgment eats a whole Demonflare.
audit.corrected: Chart set to Swain/Swain/Skill/Kayle/Kayle/Kayle/Kayle in both layers, proposed as matched pairs, with ratings realigned.

audit.whatIsWrong: Divine Judgment's 160s rank-1 cooldown is never given, Celestial Blessing's heal is never named or answered with Grievous Wounds, and Starfire Spellblade's auto reset is absent. whys[2] also claims she reaches ranged form at level 6 while sitting on the Level 3 row.
audit.why: Riot text: Divine Judgment 160/120/80s makes the target invulnerable. Celestial Blessing is a flat 15s heal on herself and the nearest ally. Starfire Spellblade is a 6-8s auto-attack reset dealing bonus damage scaled to missing health — so the wind-up, not the cast, is the tell. Kayle's passive grants range progressively as she levels, so 'ranged form at 6' does not belong on the Level 3 caption.
audit.corrected: Numbers and interactions written into breakdown.cooldowns, report[5], dosFull[0].d, dontsFull[2].d, phases[2].why, phases[4].why, whys[2], whys[4] and wants.you[2].

audit.whatIsWrong: The full layer's itemization mentions anti-heal but the content layer never tells you why or when.
audit.why: Celestial Blessing heals every 15s flat; without Grievous Wounds Swain's chip damage does not accumulate.
audit.corrected: Oblivion Orb timing written into wants.you[2] and breakdown.cooldowns.

edits.before: E-root into the pull is your whole kill setup. Only take the trade when Kayle's Divine Judgment is down.
edits.after: Nevermove roots on its return sweep and melee Kayle has no dash — every pull is a free Soul Fragment.

edits.before: Full kit online — your core pattern starts now. Keep the wave near your side so Kayle must walk into your range.
edits.after: Full kit online, but Celestial Blessing heals off your chip every 15s — trade in bursts, never in slow poke.

edits.before: Demonic Ascension turns his all-in into your healing — bait it, then drain. Reassess every all-in at 6 — Kayle's ultimate changes the math too.
edits.after: Divine Judgment makes her invulnerable through your entire Demonflare — never ult into it; bait it out first, then drain the window after.

edits.before: - Kayle Divine Judgment: matchup-defining — Her get-out at 6. Bait it. Track it before every engage. - Your committal tool: never spend it on chip. - Your ultimate: the win condition — kill windows only.
edits.after: - Divine Judgment: 160s at rank 1 — her get-out at 6, and it eats a whole Demonflare. Bait it. - Celestial Blessing: 15s heal; bring Grievous Wounds. - Starfire Spellblade: 8s auto reset scaling on your missing health.

edits.before: Track Kayle's Divine Judgment (Invuln): Her get-out at 6. Bait it. When it is down — E-root + R her.
edits.after: Divine Judgment is 160s at rank 1 and eats a full Demonflare. Bait it, then E-root and drain.

edits.before: Her get-out at 6. Bait it. Only engage once it is down or baited.
edits.after: 160s at rank 1 — bait it out, then commit. Never ult into it.

edits.before: Burning E on the wave — rootless Swain has no setup, and his all-in just became safe.
edits.after: Rootless Swain has no setup. Her Starfire Spellblade wind-up is the tell — step back on it.

edits.before: She hits ranged form at level 6 and gains her R invulnerability, turning your W-E-Q threat into a coin-flip; both of you are learning the matchup dynamic.
edits.after: Your W-into-E pattern is online, but Celestial Blessing heals a full 15s of chip off her — burst her inside one window or you simply hand the health back.

edits.before: With R online she can completely absorb your drain and nova; you are no longer safely winning extended trades and she controls the pacing.
edits.after: Divine Judgment absorbs your entire drain and Demonflare on a 160s cooldown — you cannot force a clean kill at 6 and she sets the pacing.

edits.before: Recall and complete Luden's or Shadowflame before she finishes Nashor's Tooth — your burst window closes once her on-hit online
edits.after: Buy Oblivion Orb early — Celestial Blessing heals every 15s and Grievous Wounds is what makes your chip damage stick

notes: Kayle's R is described by Riot as invulnerability; the kit's 'untargetable' flag is looser than the description, so the page now says invulnerable. Packet defect 'never names any of Kayle's abilities' is only partly closed: Divine Judgment, Celestial Blessing and Starfire Spellblade are now named, but Radiant Blast (Q, 12s at rank 1, shreds resistances) still has no home inside the length bands of the remaining fields. The packet lists games as 349 at top level and 135 inside the packet block — I used the matchup as live either way, but the discrepancy is worth a look.
